answer_1.quote: we propose a novel method Contrastive Attributed explanations for Text (CAT) which provides contrastive explanations for natural language data
answer_1.outputs: Contrastive sentences generated via perturbations (insertions, deletions, substitutions)

answer_2.quote: For each dataset, we measure the following properties: i) Flip rate (Flip), ii) Edit distance (Dist), iii) Content Preservation (Cont), and iv) Fluency.

answer_4.quote: We now describe two user studies we conducted to ascertain the value of our attributed explanations. User studies have become ubiquitous in explainable AI literature because they illustrate the benefit of these tools to the end user.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to determine the classification of the article based on the contrastive explanation and to rate explanations on four qualitative dimensions.
